title: Open the new alert rule page

blocks.content:
When an alert fires, the name is the first thing responders see, so give the rule a name that says exactly what's wrong.

In this milestone, you open a fresh alert rule form and name the rule.

blocks.title: Open the new alert rule page

blocks.content: Open the **Alert rules** page. It's in the main menu under **Alerting > Alert rules**.
Click **+ New alert rule** to start a fresh rule.
You're on the new alert rule page. Any draft you had open before is now cleared.
In the **Alert rule name** field, use **QuickPizza high error rate**. It says exactly what the rule watches.
blocks.tooltip: This name shows up first when the alert fires.

blocks.content: Next, you write the query that measures the error rate.
